actions.action: Wipe the plant with rubbing alcohol
Mix 50-50 water and alcohol and saturate the plant, repeating 2-3 times with 3-4 days between
Mix Bonide systemic granules into the top layer of soil
Alternatively spray with a mix of peppermint/tea tree castile soap, alcohol, peroxide and water, letting it dry before putting the plant under lights or in sun

verdict.reason: The comments treat the plant for a bug infestation (mealybugs) and lead with alcohol wiping and saturation, which matches the alcohol treatment that worked; the extra systemic granules and soap spray are not likely to harm the plant.
